whisper._notes: large-v3-turbo is the sweet spot: fast as base, accurate as medium, ~6GB VRAM

elevenlabs._notes: Default model is turbo (fastest). For audio tags ([laughs] etc), set elevenlabs_model_id to eleven_v3 in active-character.json. v3 stability: 0.0=Creative, 0.5=Natural, 1.0=Robust.
elevenlabs._sfx_notes: SFX and music use the same API key. Gemini embeds {{sfx: desc}} and {{music: desc | 30}} tags. SFX billed per generation.

acestep._notes: ACE-Step 1.5 local music generation. Run: docker run --gpus all -p 7860:7860 --name acestep ghcr.io/dotnetautor/ace-step-1.5-docker:latest. voice_reference: path to audio file for vocal style (null = default). Set music_engine to 'acestep' in active-character.json.

audiogen._notes: Meta AudioGen (AudioCraft) local SFX generation. Build: docker build -t audiogen-server docker/audiogen/ then run: docker run --gpus all -p 7861:7861 -v audiogen_cache:/root/.cache --name audiogen audiogen-server. Set sfx_engine to 'audiogen' in active-character.json.

chatterbox._notes: Fallback TTS when ElevenLabs not configured. reference_voice path relative to project root.

audio._ptt_notes: Use 'scroll lock' for foot pedal (most USB pedals map to this). Change to any key name from the keyboard library. Hold mode = talk while held.
audio._device_notes: input_device: null = system default. Set to device index (number) or part of device name (string) from --list-audio. Example: 32 or 'Obsidian Night'. Use --device flag to override at launch.
